sections.title: Valuation ratio correlations
sections.intro: These help assess how the market values companies relative to their financial performance.
sections.note: Priority checks: P/E vs EPS growth, P/B vs ROE, EV/EBITDA vs EBITDA growth, EV/CFO vs operating cash flow growth, and EV/Sales vs revenue growth.

sections.title: Profitability correlations
sections.intro: These identify which factors are associated with stronger profitability and returns.

sections.title: Growth correlations
sections.intro: Use these to assess whether growth in sales, earnings, assets and cash flow moves together.

sections.title: Leverage and debt correlations
sections.intro: Useful for financial risk warnings and identifying companies whose profits may be sensitive to debt.
sections.note: Sector adjustment: Debt-to-equity is less directly comparable across banks and non-financial companies. For banks, prefer capital adequacy, gross NPAs, net NPAs, loan growth and net interest margin.

sections.title: Cash flow and earnings quality correlations
sections.intro: Accounting profits do not always translate into cash.
sections.note: High-priority warning: if revenue and net profit are increasing but CFO is declining, investigate receivables, inventory, working capital and accounting accruals before drawing conclusions.

sections.title: Market price and technical indicator correlations
sections.note: For technical indicators, use time-aligned observations and test future returns over defined horizons, such as 5, 20 or 60 trading days. Same-day correlations can be misleading.

sections.title: Financial statement warning correlations
sections.note: Important: the existing rule "profit growth exceeding three times revenue growth" is best implemented as a separate warning rule, not as a correlation test. Growth rates near zero or negative can make that comparison unstable.

pe.label: P/E ratio
pe.formula: Share price / earnings per share over the last 12 months (provider, re-priced to the latest quote). Loss-makers have no P/E.

pb.label: P/B ratio
pb.formula: Share price / book value per share (provider, re-priced to the latest quote). Zero or negative equity: no P/B.

ev_ebitda.label: EV/EBITDA
ev_ebitda.formula: Enterprise value (market cap + borrowings - cash) / EBITDA of the last 12 months (provider EBITDA).

ev_sales.label: EV/Sales
ev_sales.formula: Enterprise value / sales of the latest financial year.

ev_cfo.label: EV/CFO
ev_cfo.formula: Enterprise value / operating cash flow of the latest financial year (the same year as the other FY figures). CFO zero or negative: not meaningful.

peg.label: PEG ratio
peg.formula: P/E / 5-year yearly profit growth (%). Uses profit growth, not EPS growth. Defined only when both are above zero.

mcap.label: Market cap
mcap.formula: Share price x shares outstanding, Rs crore.

dy.label: Dividend yield (%)
dy.formula: Dividends with ex-date in the last 12 months / share price x 100 (split and bonus adjusted). 0 for a company that paid nothing.

fcf_yield.label: Free cash flow yield (%)
fcf_yield.formula: Free cash flow (CFO - capital expenditure) of the latest financial year / today's market cap x 100.

cfo_yield.label: CFO yield (%)
cfo_yield.formula: Operating cash flow of the latest financial year / today's market cap x 100.

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.formula: Revenue from operations of the latest financial year, Rs crore (a lender: interest earned plus fees).

np.label: Net profit
np.formula: Net profit attributable to shareholders, continuing operations where a material discontinued profit exists, Rs crore.

ebitda.label: EBITDA
ebitda.formula: Operating profit before depreciation, interest and other income (FinLit operating profit), Rs crore.

cfo.label: Operating cash flow (CFO)
cfo.formula: Cash from operating activities, Rs crore.

fcf.label: Free cash flow (FCF)
fcf.formula: Operating cash flow - capital expenditure, Rs crore.

capex.label: Capital expenditure
capex.formula: Purchase of property, plant, equipment and intangibles (as a positive amount), Rs crore.

cur_liab.label: Current liabilities
cur_liab.formula: Current liabilities from the balance sheet, Rs crore.

opm.label: Operating margin (%)
opm.formula: FinLit operating profit (before depreciation, interest and other income: this is the EBITDA margin) / revenue x 100 (a lender: / total income).

npm.label: Net profit margin (%)
npm.formula: Net profit / revenue x 100 (a lender: / total income).

ebit_margin.label: EBIT margin (%)
ebit_margin.formula: (Profit before tax + finance costs) / revenue x 100: operating earnings after depreciation.

gross_margin.label: Gross margin (%)
gross_margin.formula: Provider's gross margin for the latest financial year (no cost-of-goods line is stored).

roe.label: ROE (%)
roe.formula: Net profit / shareholders' equity x 100. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

roce.label: ROCE (%)
roce.formula: Return on capital employed. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

roa.label: ROA (%)
roa.formula: Net profit / total assets x 100. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

de.label: Debt-to-equity
de.formula: Total debt / shareholders' equity. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

debt_assets.label: Debt-to-assets
debt_assets.formula: Total debt / total assets. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

icr.label: Interest coverage ratio
icr.formula: Operating earnings / interest cost. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

current_ratio.label: Current ratio
current_ratio.formula: Current assets / current liabilities. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

quick_ratio.label: Quick ratio
quick_ratio.formula: Current assets less inventories / current liabilities. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

asset_turnover.label: Asset turnover
asset_turnover.formula: Revenue / total assets. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

inv_days.label: Inventory days
inv_days.formula: Days of sales held as inventory. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

debtor_days.label: Receivables days
debtor_days.formula: Days customers take to pay. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

payable_days.label: Payables days
payable_days.formula: Days taken to pay suppliers. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

ccc.label: Cash conversion cycle
ccc.formula: Inventory days + receivables days - payables days. Provider's yearly ratio for the company's latest financial year (not the trailing-12-month headline).

inv_turnover.label: Inventory turnover
inv_turnover.formula: 365 / the provider's inventory days (inventory days above zero).

recv_turnover.label: Receivables turnover
recv_turnover.formula: 365 / the provider's receivables days (receivables days above zero).

cash_ratio.label: Cash ratio
cash_ratio.formula: Cash and cash equivalents / current liabilities.

nd_ebitda.label: Net debt/EBITDA
nd_ebitda.formula: (Borrowings - cash) / EBITDA, only when EBITDA is above zero. Negative means more cash than debt.

cfo_debt.label: CFO/Total debt
cfo_debt.formula: Operating cash flow / borrowings, only when there are borrowings.

cfo_pat.label: CFO/PAT
cfo_pat.formula: Operating cash flow / net profit x 100, only when net profit is above zero.

accruals.label: Accruals ratio
accruals.formula: (Net profit - operating cash flow) / average total assets of this and last year x 100.

oi_np.label: Other income/Net profit (%)
oi_np.formula: Other income / net profit x 100, only when net profit is above zero.

exc_np.label: Exceptional items/Net profit (%)
exc_np.formula: Exceptional items / net profit x 100, only when net profit is above zero. With no exceptional line the value is 0 only if the P&L reconciles to profit before tax without one.

payout.label: Dividend payout ratio (%)
payout.formula: Dividend per share declared for the year / EPS of the same year x 100 (split and bonus adjusted).

div_cover.label: Dividend cover
div_cover.formula: EPS / dividend per share for the same year (payers only).

cfo_ps.label: CFO/Share
cfo_ps.formula: Operating cash flow / diluted shares, rupees per share.

eps.label: EPS
eps.formula: Earnings per share (continuing operations where relevant).

bvps.label: Book value per share
bvps.formula: Shareholders' equity / diluted shares, rupees per share.

g_rev.label: Revenue growth (%)
g_rev.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart.

g_np.label: Net profit growth (%)
g_np.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. Net profit on continuing operations where relevant.

g_eps.label: EPS growth (%)
g_eps.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. Left out when the share count changed by more than 25% (or by more than 5% with a bonus or split).

g_ebitda.label: EBITDA growth (%)
g_ebitda.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. EBITDA = FinLit operating profit.

g_ebit.label: EBIT growth (%)
g_ebit.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. EBIT = profit before tax + finance costs.

g_pbt.label: Profit before tax growth (%)
g_pbt.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart.

g_tax.label: Tax expense growth (%)
g_tax.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. A tax credit in the earlier year means no growth figure.

g_cfo.label: CFO growth (%)
g_cfo.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart.

g_fcf.label: Free cash flow growth (%)
g_fcf.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart.

g_capex.label: Capital expenditure growth (%)
g_capex.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart.

g_assets.label: Asset growth (%)
g_assets.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. Total assets.

g_bv.label: Book value growth (%)
g_bv.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. Shareholders' equity (net worth).

g_bvps.label: Book value per share growth (%)
g_bvps.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. Left out when the share count changed by more than 25% (or by more than 5% with a bonus or split).

g_wc.label: Working capital growth (%)
g_wc.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. Working capital = current assets - current liabilities.

g_recv.label: Receivables growth (%)
g_recv.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. Trade receivables.

g_inv.label: Inventory growth (%)
g_inv.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart.

g_dep.label: Depreciation growth (%)
g_dep.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart.

g_int.label: Interest expense growth (%)
g_int.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. Finance costs.

g_debt.label: Debt growth (%)
g_debt.formula: YoY growth, latest financial year against the one before: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. Defined only when both years are reported, last year is above zero and the two period ends are 330-400 days apart. Borrowings.

g_dps.label: Dividend growth (%)
g_dps.formula: Dividend per share declared for the latest financial year against the year before (split and bonus adjusted). Both years must be complete.

ret_fy.label: Share price return (%)
ret_fy.formula: Close on the financial-year end / close on the previous financial-year end - 1, x 100 (last close on or before each date, within 7 days). Same year as the results.

tsr_fy.label: Total shareholder return (%)
tsr_fy.formula: Price return over the financial year plus dividends with ex-date inside it, as a % of the starting close.

pe_fy.label: P/E ratio (at the financial-year end)
pe_fy.formula: Close on the financial-year end / EPS of that year (EPS above zero).

pb_fy.label: P/B ratio (at the financial-year end)
pb_fy.formula: Close on the financial-year end / book value per share of that year (equity above zero).

vol3y.label: Share price volatility
vol3y.formula: Standard deviation of daily log returns over the last 756 sessions x sqrt(252) x 100 (needs at least 700 sessions).

mdd3y.label: Maximum drawdown
mdd3y.formula: Largest fall from a peak to a later low of the daily close over the last 756 sessions, in % (negative).

inst_chg.label: Institutional ownership change (%)
inst_chg.formula: Change in foreign + domestic institutional holding over the last year, in percentage points (latest shareholding quarter against the same quarter a year earlier).

ret_inst.label: Share price return (%)
ret_inst.formula: Price return between the same two shareholding quarter-ends.

pe_sig.label: P/E ratio (75 days after the year end)
pe_sig.formula: Close 75 days after the financial-year end (past the 60-day results deadline) / EPS of that year. Latest year whose next 12 months are complete.

pb_sig.label: P/B ratio (75 days after the year end)
pb_sig.formula: Close 75 days after the financial-year end / book value per share of that year.

g_eps_sig.label: EPS growth (%) (signal year)
g_eps_sig.formula: EPS growth of the financial year used for the signal.

g_rev_sig.label: Revenue growth (%) (signal year)
g_rev_sig.formula: Revenue growth of the financial year used for the signal.

fwd12.label: Share price return over the next 12 months (%)
fwd12.formula: Close 12 calendar months after the signal date / close on the signal date - 1, x 100. No look-ahead: the signal uses only results published by then.

sales_per_employee.label: Revenue per employee
sales_per_employee.formula: Latest-year revenue / headcount from the company profile (the headcount date is not known), Rs crore.

rsi.label: RSI (14 days, Wilder)
rsi.formula: Wilder's 14-day relative strength index on daily closes up to the signal day.

macd_pct.label: MACD histogram (% of price)
macd_pct.formula: (EMA12 - EMA26 - EMA9 of that difference) / close x 100, on closes up to the signal day.

p52h.label: Price-to-52-week-high (%)
p52h.formula: Close / highest close of the last 252 sessions x 100.

volg.label: Trading volume growth (%)
volg.formula: Total volume of a 20-session window / total volume of the previous 20 sessions - 1, x 100.

abs_ret.label: Absolute price return (%)
abs_ret.formula: Absolute price change over the same 20-session window, in %.

fwd_ret.label: Next-period return (%)
fwd_ret.formula: Close h trading days after the signal day / close on the signal day - 1, x 100 (h = 5, 20 or 60).

mkt_ret.label: Market return (%)
mkt_ret.formula: NIFTY 50 weekly return (last close of each ISO week).

stock_ret.label: Stock weekly return (%)
stock_ret.formula: The company's weekly return (last close of each ISO week).

reasons.no_report: No stored full report for this company yet: open its page to load it.
reasons.preparing: This company's figures for these charts are being prepared (refresh pending).
reasons.unknown: Not in our list of listed companies.
reasons.outside: Outside the chosen filters: shown for reference, not part of the statistics.
reasons.lender: Banks and lenders left out: this ratio does not apply to lenders.
reasons.neg_equity: Negative or zero equity: the ratio would mislead.
reasons.no_fy: No figure for the company's latest financial year.
reasons.non_march: The company's financial year does not end in March, so the provider's yearly ratio is not available.
reasons.no_data: Not reported in the company's stored statements.
reasons.loss: Loss-making: a price multiple or a ratio on profit is not meaningful.
reasons.np_le0: Net profit is zero or negative: a ratio on profit is not meaningful.
reasons.cfo_le0: Operating cash flow is zero or negative: EV/CFO is not meaningful.
reasons.op_le0: Operating profit (EBITDA) is zero or negative: the ratio is not meaningful.
reasons.no_debt: No borrowings: the ratio is not defined.
reasons.no_prev: No earlier year to measure growth from.
reasons.base_le0: Growth not defined: the earlier year was zero or negative (a swing from a loss is not growth).
reasons.gap: The two years are not consecutive (period ends not 330-400 days apart).
reasons.share_change: The share count changed by more than 25% (or by more than 5% with a bonus or split): per-share growth is not comparable.
reasons.partial: The dividend year is not complete, or is not the same year as the results.
reasons.no_growth: No positive 5-year profit growth to divide by.
reasons.start_gap: No close within 7 days of the start or end of the window.
reasons.jump: A split, bonus or a one-day price move of more than 80% inside the window: the return is not computed.
reasons.basis: The stored daily closes could not be confirmed to be on the provider's split/bonus-adjusted basis for this window.
reasons.not_complete: The 12 months after the signal date have not passed yet.
reasons.no_market: No NIFTY 50 history for these weeks.
reasons.warmup: The indicator needs more earlier prices at this date.
reasons.log_le0: Zero or negative: cannot be placed on a log scale.
reasons.fy_mismatch: Results year differs from the majority ("Same FY only" is on).
reasons.trimmed: Left out by "leave out the most extreme 1%".
reasons.no_value: No value (not reported by the provider, or not meaningful).
reasons.not_lender: Not a bank or lender (this chart shows lenders only).
reasons.no_volume: Trading volume missing for some days in the window.
reasons.no_list: The member list of this index is not stored.

decisions.few: Too few points for a reliable line (n = {n}).
decisions.no_spread: No line: the values do not vary.
decisions.weak: Statistically detectable but too weak to be useful (explains under 9%).
decisions.one_company: No line: the line depends on one company ({name}).
decisions.curved: No straight line: the relationship is curved.
decisions.pulled: Extreme values pull the straight line: both the straight line and a robust (Theil-Sen) line are drawn.
decisions.ok: A straight line is drawn with its 95% band.

caveats: p-values assume the companies are independent; companies in one sector move together, so the p-values overstate certainty.
With about 130 charts, roughly 1 in 20 will look statistically significant by chance alone.
coverageNote: Only companies with a stored full report are charted: mostly the largest listed companies, not all listed companies.
